mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_attachment (ticket_id, message_id, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, upload_by) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{messageId}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{uploadBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_id, message_id, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, upload_by, create_time FROM ticket_attachment WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
